name: 43947 · Shadyside, OH
findings: ZIP 43947 (Shadyside) has 8 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43947 (Shadyside) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 43947 (Shadyside) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
